implemented_capabilities.capability: Service dependency blast radius with FalkorDB algo.SSpaths cross-checked against variable-length Cypher
implemented_capabilities.notes: Calls CALL algo.SSpaths({sourceNode, relTypes:['DEPENDS_ON'], relDirection:'incoming', maxLen:6, pathCount}) and independently runs MATCH (dep)-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..6]->(s); uses SSpaths only if the id sets agree, otherwise falls back to the Cypher result. Depth cap 6. Opens/updates an Incident (MERGE, idempotent) with severity sev1 if any dependent is tier 0.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Fraud ring / linked-account component via algo.WCC with verification and fallback
implemented_capabilities.notes: Runs CALL algo.WCC on Account/LINKED_TO (two call signatures tried), verifies the component equals the LINKED_TO*0..6 neighbourhood, else falls back to variable-length Cypher. Then freezes all component accounts (SET status='frozen') and writes a Decision. Fraud scoring is only a 'flagged' boolean on seed data; no scoring model.

Person-WORKED_ON->Project-USES->Service traversal, ON_CALL_FOR / OWNS role precedence, and CALL algo.pageRank('Person','KNOWS') only when no on-call/owner exists (test_notifications_page_uses_pagerank).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Decision lineage lookup (human vs agent decisions, CITES documents)
implemented_capabilities.notes: MATCH (d:Decision {source:'human'})-[:ABOUT]->(:Incident)-[:AFFECTS]->(s:Service) ... OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:CITES]->(doc) ORDER BY decided_at DESC LIMIT 1. Agent-authored decisions carry source='agent' and are excluded so they never overwrite human precedent (test_human_decision_survives_agent_decision).

implemented_capabilities.capability: Per-user graph memory (episodic, semantic, procedural) with cross-session recall
implemented_capabilities.notes: Each operator gets a separate FalkorDB graph memory_<user_id> with User-HAD_EPISODE->Episode, User-REMEMBERS->Fact and User-FOLLOWS->Procedure. A stored procedure overrides company on-call in blast_radius (page_reason=PROCEDURE_OVERRIDE) without mutating the company graph.

Each tool result lists handoffs (coordinator->impact->people etc.) that are persisted as (:Agent)-[:HANDED_OFF {run_id, reason, ts, user_id, session_id}]->(:Agent) in a 'coord' graph. The 'agents' are labels for code paths, not autonomous agents.
Keyword/regex rules with hard-coded service and staff alias tables handle the demo questions; an xAI Grok call (model string 'grok-4.7') is a fallback tool picker only. Not general NL understanding.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Customer ticket history with date-window query
implemented_capabilities.notes: Works only on synthetic Harbor Pay data; the 'last month' window is hard-coded to September 2026 constants in seed.py, not computed from a clock.

graph_models_and_cypher: Company graph 'harbor' (synthetic): Service(id,name,tier), Person, Team, Project, Account(status), Transaction(flagged), Customer, Ticket, Incident, Decision(source human|agent, decided_at), Document, Procedure, Agent. Edges: DEPENDS_ON{weight}, ON_CALL_FOR, OWNS, WORKED_ON, USES, KNOWS, MEMBER_OF, LINKED_TO, FROM_ACCOUNT, TO_ACCOUNT, FILED, ABOUT, AFFECTS, DECIDED_BY, PAGES, CITES, ASSIGNED_TO. Per-user graphs memory_<user_id> (User/Episode/Fact/Procedure) and a 'coord' graph (Agent-HANDED_OFF->Agent). Cypher uses parameters throughout, UNWIND $ids ... SET for bulk freeze, MERGE for idempotent incident/decision upserts, [n IN nodes(path) | n.id] list comprehensions. Uses FalkorDB-native procedures algo.SSpaths, algo.WCC, algo.pageRank (not Neo4j GDS/APOC), plus CREATE INDEX FOR (n:L) ON (n.p) with legacy fallback.
algorithms: Reverse-reachability blast radius: algo.SSpaths(relDirection incoming, maxLen 6) cross-validated against DEPENDS_ON*1..6 in agents.py:_dependent_ids
Weakly connected components on LINKED_TO via algo.WCC with self-verification against a bounded walk in agents.py:_fraud_component/_require_same_component
PageRank over Person-KNOWS via algo.pageRank as a tie-breaker in agents.py:_page_rank
Shortest dependency path per dependent chosen by min len(nodes) in agents.py:_dependency_paths
Role precedence for paging: procedural-memory override > ON_CALL_FOR > OWNS > pageRank > WORKED_ON in agents.py:blast_radius/who_knows
frontend_interfaces: static/index.html + static/app.js: chat panel, preset questions, trace panel rendering paths, actions, handoffs, memory and the exact Cypher executed (all values passed through escapeHtml)
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: Coordinator -> impact/people/fraud/support/company 'agents' are named handoff hops over deterministic tool functions, recorded in a coord graph. Memory is three-tier per user (Episode, Fact, Procedure) in separate graphs; procedure memory changes later decisions. Every answer returns the executed Cypher so results are auditable.
tests_present: tests/test_agents.py (~14 tests: blast radius for ledger/status-page/card-network, per-operator standing orders, idempotent incident, pageRank vs on-call, fraud component freeze, date window, human decision precedence, cross-session recall, parallel writes, HTTP ask) and tests/test_planner.py (~5 rule-planner tests). Agent tests are skipped unless a live FalkorDB is reachable.
security_findings: app/main.py:71-81 - POST /api/reset is unauthenticated and deletes/reseeds harbor, coord and every memory_* graph (app/seed.py:407-420)

app/agents.py:418-426 - fraud_ring executes UNWIND ... SET a.status='frozen' directly from a chat question with no approval gate or authz; app/agents.py:105-123 likewise writes Incident/Decision rows from a read-style question
app/main.py:43-47 - user_id is client-supplied with no authentication (only regex-validated by app/db.py:10,45); any caller can read/write another operator's memory_<user_id> graph
app/planner.py:164-185 - outbound HTTPS call to api.x.ai with Bearer XAI_API_KEY read from env (no hard-coded key); question text sent to a third party; model id 'grok-4.7' is hard-coded
app/agents.py:1004-1011 - f-string Cypher with relationship type, but guarded by an {ON_CALL_FOR, OWNS} whitelist (not injectable)
app/seed.py:386-387 - f-string index DDL with label/prop from constants (not injectable)
app/db.py:17-18 - FalkorDB credentials from env FALKORDB_USERNAME/PASSWORD; defaults to unauthenticated localhost:6379
app/agents.py:1150 - executed Cypher plus params are echoed back to the client in the 'cypher' field (information disclosure of query shapes; params include IDs only)
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps blast-radius traversal (Argus/blastradius style), fraud-ring WCC (hound-aml, FraudTrace-AI), expert-finder/on-call routing and agent-memory families. Most architecturally aligned with Kairos because it targets FalkorDB natively.
evidence_drift_relevance: MEDIUM - persists Decision nodes with DECIDED_BY/ABOUT/CITES lineage, separates human vs agent decision provenance, and layers per-user procedural memory over the company graph, but it has no temporal validity windows, supersession edges or invalidation propagation.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small, working pattern for calling FalkorDB-native graph algorithms (SSpaths, WCC, pageRank) with self-verification against plain Cypher and fallback, returning the exact Cypher used as an audit trail. Directly matches the FalkorDB 4.x server and falkordb 1.x client Kairos uses.
strongest_reusable_unit.external_runtime_needed: FalkorDB server (algo.* procedures); no LLM key required for core paths

strategy_rationale: The verified-algorithm-with-fallback helpers and the Decision/Episode/Procedure memory schema can be lifted into a Kairos shared graph-engine module; the keyword planner, hard-coded Harbor Pay seed and unauthenticated mutation endpoints should not be copied.
